article.summary_es: Esta iglesia en Brooklyn aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos. Abre los sábados de 12pm a 2pm.
article.summary_en: This Brooklyn church is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad.
Entrega alimentos los sábados de 12pm a 2pm.
Está en 3304 Clarendon Rd, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
Puede llamar al (718) 469-9251 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Listed as a food pantry on the City's Food Help NYC map.
Distributes food on Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm.
Located at 3304 Clarendon Rd, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
You can call (718) 469-9251 to ask questions before visiting.
